title: Very overpriced for amount of items.
text: Very overpriced for amount of items.. Was pretty disappointed when I saw the quality thinking wow how much did I pay for this? I was in a bind needing party supplies, and wasn’t sure Party city would ship in time. I saw this and thought okay it has the whole party pack. The picture looked very full. My fault for not checking the description. No cups, only 8 plates. No silverware, no balloons. You don’t get many things at all. This would never be able to host a party. I thought the quality was going to be elegant and worth the high price but it’s on par with the dollar tree. I will stick with party city next time. Eek.
